title: Janitor Robot | Alai Labs
description: A cleaning robot that maps restrooms with LIDAR and cleans them, while your team watches and controls it in a 3D view.

head.p_1: A cleaning robot that maps restrooms with LIDAR and cleans them, while your team watches and controls it in a 3D view.

img_1.alt: Alai Janitor Robot, a white wheeled robot with two robotic arms and a control panel on top

about.caption_1: Product image. Photos and a video of the product at work are to come; the video will play only when you press play.
about.p_1: The Janitor Robot is built for facility management teams responsible for restroom cleaning. It maps each restroom with LIDAR, cleans it, and links to a 3D view of the site so staff can control and monitor it remotely.

specs.td_3: 3D digital twin (Metaverse) view for control and monitoring
